full_judgment:
Mr. Shahidul Islam, J.:-By this Rule the Opposite Party was directed to show cause as to why the impugned Judgment and decree dated 1.7.11.2001 passed by the Joint District Judge, 1s` Court, Nilphamari, in Family Appeal No. 11 of 2002 dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and decree dated 30.4.2001 by the Family Court, Kishoreganj, Nilphamari, in Family Suit No. 21 of 1999 decreeing the suit should not be set aside and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 5. The 'trial Court or considering the evidence on record decreed the suit by the judgment and decree dated 3.0.4.2001. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the impugned judgment and decree the Defendant preferred-Family Appeal No., 11 of 2001 and the said appeal was heard by the Sub-ordinate. Judge, Nilphamari, who also on considering the evidence on record dismissed the: appeal by the judgment and decree. , dated: 17.11.2001, affirming the judgment and .decree of the trial Court. 

 7. Being aggrieved by .the said judgment and decree the Defendant has moved this Court and has 'obtained the instant Rule. 

 9. Mr. Md. Sajjad Ali Chowdhury, the learned Advocate on appearing for the Opposite Party submitted that the impugned judgment and decree being based on concurrent finding of facts the same is not liable to be interfered by this Court. 

 12. In the result, the Rule is discharged with costs. The impugned Judgment and decree dated 17.11.2001 passed by the Joint District Judge, I Court, Nilphamari in Family Appeal No. 11 of 2002 dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and decree dated 30.4 2001 by the Family Court, Kishoregarij, Nilphamari, in Family Suit. No. 21 of 1999 is hereby affirmed.
